title: Ostension (folklore) — legend enacted / misread as reality
why: [folklore encyclopedia (contemporary legend)] Claim: **Ostension** = real-life happenings shaped by a pre-existing legend. Pure ostension acts the legend out; **pseudo-ostension** fabricates evidence/hoaxes to look like the legend; **quasi-ostension** misreads ambiguous evidence *as* the legend (many media panics).
